questions.question: A is taller than B, and B is taller than C. Who is the tallest?
questions.explanation: A > B > C, so A is the tallest.

questions.question: P is heavier than Q and R is lighter than Q. Who is the lightest?
questions.explanation: P > Q > R, so R is the lightest.

questions.question: Which of these words comes first in dictionary order: Table, Tablet, Tab, Tabby?
questions.explanation: Tab is a prefix of the others and comes first: Tab, Tabby, Table, Tablet.

questions.question: If the day after tomorrow is Friday, the day before yesterday was
questions.explanation: Today is Wednesday. The day before yesterday was Monday.

questions.question: If the 5th of a month is a Monday, the 12th of that month is a
questions.explanation: 12 − 5 = 7 days later, the same weekday.

questions.question: Which is the correct order of the life cycle of a butterfly?
questions.explanation: A butterfly develops from an egg to a larva (caterpillar), then a pupa, then an adult.

questions.question: A is taller than B. C is shorter than B but taller than D. E is the tallest. The second tallest is
questions.explanation: E > A > B > C > D, so A is second.

questions.question: P is richer than Q, R is richer than P and S is poorer than Q. The second richest is
questions.explanation: R > P > Q > S, so P is second.

questions.question: Arrange Planet, Plane, Plant and Plain in dictionary order. The third word is
questions.explanation: Plain, Plane, Planet, Plant. The third is Planet.

questions.question: Arrange: 1. Bath 2. Wake up 3. Breakfast 4. Go to school. The correct order is
questions.explanation: The order is 2, 1, 3, 4: wake up, bath, breakfast, go to school.

questions.question: A is older than B, C is younger than B and D is older than A. The youngest is
questions.explanation: D > A > B > C. C is the youngest.

questions.question: If the day before yesterday was Thursday, tomorrow will be
questions.explanation: Today is Saturday, so tomorrow is Sunday.

questions.question: D is taller than E but shorter than A. B is taller than A. C is shorter than E. The person in the middle by height is
questions.explanation: B > A > D > E > C. The middle (third) is D.

questions.question: Arrange Cat, Cart, Car and Cab in dictionary order. The last word is
questions.explanation: Cab, Car, Cart, Cat.

questions.question: A is faster than B, C is slower than D, B is faster than D and E is faster than A. The third fastest is
questions.explanation: E > A > B > D > C. The third is B.

questions.question: 1 January 2021 was a Friday. 1 March 2021 was a
questions.explanation: Days between = 31 + 28 = 59, which leaves 3 when divided by 7. Friday + 3 = Monday.

questions.question: Heights: A = 150 cm, B = 165 cm, C = 158 cm, D = 160 cm, E = 170 cm. Arranged in increasing order, D is at position
P is heavier than Q and R. S is lighter than Q but heavier than T. T is heavier than R. The second lightest is
questions.explanation: P > Q > S > T > R. The second lightest is T.

questions.question: Arranged in decreasing order of size: Village, District, State, Country, Continent. The third is
questions.explanation: Continent > Country > State > District > Village. The third is State.

questions.question: 15 August 2024 was a Thursday. 26 August 2024 was a
questions.explanation: 11 days later; 11 leaves 4 when divided by 7. Thursday + 4 = Monday.
